title: Idle speed
text: With the engine warm and no load change, the idle speed stays within 800 ± 20 rpm.

title: Load rejection
text: When the AC compressor switches on, the idle speed drops by less than 50 rpm and is back within ± 20 rpm after 4 s.

title: Stall protection
text: Even without the AC feed-forward the engine must not stall: the speed stays above 600 rpm.

title: Calibratable target
text: The idle target is a calibration parameter (rpm_idle)
source: the engine reaches a new target within ± 15 rpm.

title: Limited correction
text: The controller's correction is limited to 15° of throttle, and a large target change still settles without windup.
